about_short_description.short_description: Pillar is an all-in-one creator store & media kit that powers the world's biggest creator businesses

product.name: Link-in-Bio Store
product.description: A customizable online store integrated into a creator's social media bio to build, host, and sell digital and physical products directly to followers.

product.name: Media Kits & Campaign Reports
product.description: A digital media kit that automatically updates with real-time audience and engagement statistics to help creators secure brand deals and partnerships.

product.name: Landing Pages & Funnels
product.description: A drag-and-drop platform for creating customizable landing pages and sales funnels to promote products, capture leads, and register event sign-ups without coding.

product.name: Customer Analytics & CRM
product.description: A set of analytics and customer relationship management tools that track follower engagement and sales metrics to help creators understand and grow their audience.

product.name: Email Marketing
product.description: An email marketing platform that enables creators to design and send targeted email campaigns to engage and nurture their audience.
